description: Governed process-environment settings of the synthesis backend (:5000, dev-aenv1): an allow-list of variables (the ASIO output map, the ASIO buffer size, the MIDI-listen override), persisted in the gitignored local settings file and winning over the inherited environment. Unknown and secret-looking variables are refused.

commands.name: env.get
commands.title: Read the environment settings
commands.description: Every allow-listed backend environment variable: name, description, target process, value_format, value (effective), source (setting = saved here, env = inherited from the launcher, unset), setting, inherited, applies (next_load = takes effect on the next preset load; restart = needs a backend restart), restart_pending, doc. Secret-looking values are masked.

commands.name: env.set
commands.title: Set an environment setting
commands.description: Sets ONE allow-listed backend environment variable (see env.get for the list and formats), persisted in the local settings file (survives restarts, wins over the launcher's environment). value null or "" clears the setting (back to the inherited value). applies next_load: written into the backend process now, used on the NEXT preset load (preset.load / a reload); the running engine is unchanged. applies restart: saved only, restart_required = true; nothing restarts by itself. Unknown or invalid -> 400 with the reason. Result = the new state + previous (the setting before, for an undo) + effect. Example: name PIANOID_AUDIO_OUTPUT_MAP, value "8,9,2,3,4,5,6" routes engine channels 0-6 to Out 9, Out 10, Out 3-7.
